project_info.application_name: AWS Connected Vehicle Solution - Vehicle Registration Feature
project_info.architecture_type: Serverless microservices architecture with event-driven API-based interactions
security_objectives: Ensure data integrity for vehicle registration records
Maintain availability of vehicle registration services
Protect data in transit and at rest
Prevent unauthorized access to sensitive vehicle data
entry_points: Amazon API Gateway REST endpoints (ListVehicles, RegisterVehicle, DeregisterVehicle, DescribeVehicle)
Pre-signed S3 URLs for document access
trust_boundaries: Between user browser and AWS Amplify front-end
Between AWS Amplify and Amazon Cognito (authentication)
Between user browser and API Gateway (API requests)
Between API Gateway and Lambda functions
Between Lambda functions and DynamoDB tables
Between Lambda functions and S3 bucket
Between user browser and S3 bucket (via pre-signed URLs)
Between AWS services within the same region
Between authenticated users and backend services
project_info.summary:
The AWS Connected Vehicle Solution is a serverless fleet management system focused on vehicle registration functionality. The architecture uses AWS Amplify for the web front-end, Amazon Cognito for user authentication, API Gateway for REST API endpoints, Lambda functions for business logic, DynamoDB for structured data storage, and S3 for PDF document storage.

Key security features include:
- Authentication via Amazon Cognito (note: MFA not currently used)
- Authorization through API Gateway with single scope for all operations
- Encryption at rest for both DynamoDB and S3
- TLS/SSL for data in transit
- Pre-signed URLs for secure S3 access
- Server-side encryption for S3 objects
- IAM-based access controls
- CloudWatch logging and monitoring
- AWS WAF and Shield for DDoS protection

The system supports four main API operations:
1. ListVehicles - Returns all available IoT-connected vehicles
2. RegisterVehicle - Registers vehicles with PDF upload to S3
3. DeregisterVehicle - Removes registration and deletes PDF from S3
4. DescribeVehicle - Returns vehicle info with pre-signed URL for PDF access

Key security concerns identified:
- Password spray attacks against Cognito (no MFA)
- Insufficient authorization controls (all users can perform all operations)
- Potential for API parameter manipulation
- Risk of sensitive data in Lambda logs
- Insider threats with AWS account access
- Data deletion risks in S3 and DynamoDB
- Phishing risks with similar domain names
- Trust assumption between API Gateway and Lambda (no additional authentication)

The threat model identifies 11 specific threats ranging from high to low priority, with mitigations including input validation, monitoring, detective controls, IAM best practices, and AWS security services integration.
